method: Inspected all17 frozen atlas pages then all94 extracted orders in8 central-crop enlargement pages. Full31x33 atlas retains surrounding charge context; enlarged21x13 central pixels reveal faint trace morphology without neighboring calibration-fiber domination. Display scaling is recorded and is not a classification threshold. Every unsupported covering order retains M.
independence: Separate AI-agent judgment; no secondary reviewer file or dispositions were read. Selection, prior project context and mapping flags were known; this is not blinded validation and not human review.

code_legend.O: OI-compatible photon-like feature; not proven atmospheric origin

limitations: Provisional descriptive morphology, not established physical origin.
No independent sky fiber was available in these16 exposures.
OI combines topocentric wavelength compatibility and photon-compatible raw morphology; no wavelength-only assignment.
A compact artifact can coexist with weaker spectral structure; possible blend explicitly retained forV2E2-0055.
No qualified laser candidate, calibrated null, global false-alarm rate or sensitivity estimate follows.
